Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.aspects.annotations

Annotation Interface Recoverable

@Target({METHOD,TYPE}) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Documented public @interface Recoverable
Marks a method for automatic error recovery with retry logic.

Methods annotated with @Recoverable will be automatically retried by the ErrorRecoveryAspect when they throw exceptions. The retry behavior can be customized using the annotation parameters.

Example usage: 


 @Recoverable(maxRetries = 3, delay = 1000, backoff = 2.0)
 public ActionResult performCriticalAction() {
     // Action that might fail transiently
 }

 @Recoverable(retryOn = {NetworkException.class}, skipOn = {ValidationException.class})
 public void networkOperation() {
     // Only retry on network errors
 }

  • Element Details

    • maxRetries

      int maxRetries
      Maximum number of retry attempts. Default is 3 attempts.
      Default:
      3

    • delay

      long delay
      Initial delay between retries in milliseconds. Default is 1000ms (1 second).
      Default:
      1000L

    • backoff

      double backoff
      Exponential backoff multiplier. Each retry delay will be multiplied by this factor. Default is 2.0 (doubling delay each time).
      Default:
      2.0

    • timeout

      long timeout
      Maximum total time to spend retrying in milliseconds. Default is 30000ms (30 seconds). Set to -1 for no timeout.
      Default:
      30000L

    • retryOn

      Class<? extends Throwable>[] retryOn
      Exception types that should trigger a retry. Empty array means retry on any exception.
      Default:
      {}

    • skipOn

      Class<? extends Throwable>[] skipOn
      Exception types that should NOT trigger a retry. Takes precedence over retryOn.
      Default:
      {}

    • jitter

      boolean jitter
      Whether to use jitter to randomize retry delays. Helps prevent thundering herd problems. Default is true.
      Default:
      true

    • strategy

      Recoverable.RecoveryStrategy strategy
      Recovery strategy to use.
      Default:
      EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF

    • fallbackMethod

      String fallbackMethod
      Fallback method name to call if all retries fail. Method must have the same parameters as the annotated method. Empty string means no fallback.
      Default:
      ""

    • logRetries

      boolean logRetries
      Whether to log retry attempts. Default is true.
      Default:
      true
